title: Revenue neto de los ultimos 12 meses desagregado por pais y trimestre
reference_query:
WITH pedidos_h1 AS (
    -- Todos los pedidos de H1 2026 (por fecha de creación del pedido)
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_pedidos
    FROM orders
    WHERE ordered_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND ordered_at <  '2026-07-01'
),
pagos_h1 AS (
    -- Pagos procesados en H1 2026 (por fecha efectiva de pago)
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS cobrado,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded'  THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS reembolsado,
        -- Contamos todos los intentos de pago, incluyendo failed y pending
        COUNT(*)                                                    AS total_intentos,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed'    THEN 1     ELSE 0 END)  AS intentos_fallidos
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND paid_at <  '2026-07-01'
),
devoluciones_h1 AS (
    -- Returns aprobados cuya devolución ocurrió en H1 2026
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT return_id) AS devoluciones_aprobadas
    FROM returns
    WHERE returned_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND returned_at <  '2026-07-01'
      AND status IN ('approved')
)
SELECT
    p.total_pedidos,
    ROUND(pg.cobrado - pg.reembolsado, 2)                    AS revenue_neto,
    ROUND(
        d.devoluciones_aprobadas * 100.0
        / NULLIF(p.total_pedidos, 0),
        2
    )                                                        AS tasa_devolucion_pct,
    ROUND(
        pg.intentos_fallidos * 100.0
        / NULLIF(pg.total_intentos, 0),
        2
    )                                                        AS tasa_fallo_pago_pct
FROM pedidos_h1 p
CROSS JOIN pagos_h1 pg
CROSS JOIN devoluciones_h1 d;
notes: Este es el KPI central del Capstone. El resultado de esta pregunta debe ser la fuente de verdad que los demas resultados respetan. Un analista excelente verificara que los totales de la P1 son coherentes con los subtotales de P4, P6 y P7. La interpretacion debe mencionar la tendencia, no solo los numeros.

title: Segmentacion de clientes en 4 niveles de valor con revenue por segmento
reference_query:
WITH revenue_mensual AS (
    SELECT
        STRFTIME('%Y-%m', paid_at)                               AS mes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS cobrado,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded'  THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS reembolsado
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND paid_at <  '2026-07-01'
      AND paid_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', paid_at)
)
SELECT
    mes,
    ROUND(cobrado - reembolsado, 2)                              AS revenue_neto,
    ROUND(
        LAG(cobrado - reembolsado) OVER (ORDER BY mes),
        2
    )                                                            AS revenue_anterior,
    -- Variación MoM: positivo = crecimiento, negativo = caída
    ROUND(
        (
            (cobrado - reembolsado)
            - LAG(cobrado - reembolsado) OVER (ORDER BY mes)
        ) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(
            LAG(cobrado - reembolsado) OVER (ORDER BY mes),
            0
        ),
        2
    )                                                            AS variacion_pct
FROM revenue_mensual
ORDER BY mes;
notes: El seed tiene 550 clientes. Con los datos del seed, la mayoria de clientes tiene muchos pedidos (el minimo es ~16 pedidos, el maximo es ~176). Esto significa que la segmentacion sugerida (0 / 1-3 / 4-10 / mas de 10) puede dejar muy pocos clientes en los segmentos bajos. El analista excelente ajusta los umbrales de segmentacion a la distribucion real del dataset y justifica el ajuste.

title: Revenue historico y tasa de conversion por canal de adquisicion
reference_query:
WITH pagos_pais AS (
    -- Revenue y métricas de pago por país, H1 2026
    SELECT
        c.country,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id)                               AS pedidos,
        COUNT(*)                                                 AS total_intentos,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'completed' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS cobrado,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'refunded'  THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS reembolsado,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'failed'    THEN 1        ELSE 0 END) AS fallos
    FROM payments p
    INNER JOIN orders o    ON o.order_id    = p.order_id
    INNER JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE p.paid_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND p.paid_at <  '2026-07-01'
    GROUP BY c.country
),
devoluciones_pais AS (
    -- Returns aprobados por país, H1 2026
    -- Necesitamos llegar al país desde return → order → customer
    SELECT
        c.country,
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.return_id) AS devoluciones_aprobadas
    FROM returns r
    INNER JOIN orders o    ON o.order_id    = r.order_id
    INNER JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE r.returned_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND r.returned_at <  '2026-07-01'
      AND r.status = 'approved'
    GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT
    pp.country                                                   AS pais,
    ROUND(pp.cobrado - pp.reembolsado, 2)                        AS revenue_neto,
    pp.pedidos,
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(dp.devoluciones_aprobadas, 0) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(pp.pedidos, 0),
        2
    )                                                            AS tasa_devolucion_pct,
    ROUND(
        pp.fallos * 100.0
        / NULLIF(pp.total_intentos, 0),
        2
    )                                                            AS tasa_fallo_pago_pct
FROM pagos_pais pp
LEFT JOIN devoluciones_pais dp ON dp.country = pp.country
ORDER BY revenue_neto DESC
LIMIT 5;
notes: Esta pregunta requiere las tablas website_sessions y marketing_campaigns ademas de payments, lo que la hace la mas compleja en terminos de numero de tablas. La definicion de 'canal de adquisicion' (primera sesion del cliente) es critica — un error aqui invalida toda la metrica.

title: Funnel completo por pais en Q1 2026 con tasa de caida por etapa
reference_query:
WITH revenue_bruto AS (
    -- Revenue e información de ventas por producto
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity)                                         AS unidades_vendidas,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)                         AS revenue_bruto
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
devoluciones_aprobadas AS (
    -- NOTA: returns no tiene campo de cantidad ni monto.
    -- Contamos cada return aprobado como una unidad devuelta.
    -- El impacto en revenue se aproxima multiplicando por el
    -- precio promedio del producto (revenue_bruto / unidades_vendidas).
    SELECT
        product_id,
        COUNT(return_id) AS devoluciones
    FROM returns
    WHERE status = 'approved'
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT
    p.name                                                       AS producto,
    cat.name                                                     AS categoria,
    rb.unidades_vendidas,
    ROUND(rb.revenue_bruto, 2)                                   AS revenue_bruto,
    COALESCE(da.devoluciones, 0)                                 AS devoluciones_aprobadas,
    -- Revenue neto: descontamos el precio promedio por cada devolución aprobada
    ROUND(
        rb.revenue_bruto
        - COALESCE(da.devoluciones, 0)
          * (rb.revenue_bruto / NULLIF(rb.unidades_vendidas, 0)),
        2
    )                                                            AS revenue_neto_aprox,
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(da.devoluciones, 0) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(rb.unidades_vendidas, 0),
        2
    )                                                            AS margen_devolucion_pct
FROM revenue_bruto rb
INNER JOIN products   p   ON p.product_id   = rb.product_id
INNER JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
LEFT JOIN  devoluciones_aprobadas da ON da.product_id = rb.product_id
ORDER BY revenue_neto_aprox DESC
LIMIT 10;
notes: El funnel tiene una imprecision inherente: las sesiones y los pedidos son granularidades distintas y no siempre se corresponden 1:1 en el mismo trimestre. El analista excelente documenta esta limitacion. La anomalia de Chile en Q1 2026 (pagos fallidos de la Pregunta 7) puede manifestarse aqui como baja tasa de entrega.

title: Cohorte Q3 2025 — retencion mensual en octubre, noviembre y diciembre 2025
reference_query:
SELECT
    status,
    COUNT(*)                                                     AS total_pedidos,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(*) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0),
        2
    )                                                            AS pct_del_total
FROM orders
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY total_pedidos DESC;
notes: Esta es la pregunta mas tecnica del Capstone desde el punto de vista de la logica de cohortes. El error mas comun es confundir la definicion de cohorte (primera compra en Q3) con compras realizadas en Q3. Segun la narrativa del seed, Q3 2025 es cuando entran los clientes premium de hogar (customer_id 521-550), lo que puede hacer que la cohorte sea pequena y la retencion alta.

title: Top 10 productos por revenue neto descontando devoluciones
reference_query:
WITH revenue_mensual_pais AS (
    -- Revenue neto por país y mes, histórico completo
    SELECT
        c.country,
        STRFTIME('%Y-%m', p.paid_at)                             AS mes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'completed' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'refunded' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_neto
    FROM payments p
    INNER JOIN orders o    ON o.order_id    = p.order_id
    INNER JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE p.paid_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.country, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', p.paid_at)
),
con_promedio AS (
    -- Agregamos el promedio histórico del país como window function
    SELECT
        country,
        mes,
        revenue_neto,
        -- AVG sin ROWS/RANGE: calcula sobre toda la partición del país
        AVG(revenue_neto) OVER (PARTITION BY country)            AS promedio_historico
    FROM revenue_mensual_pais
)
SELECT
    country                                                      AS pais,
    mes,
    ROUND(revenue_neto, 2)                                       AS revenue_neto_mes,
    ROUND(promedio_historico, 2)                                 AS promedio_historico,
    ROUND(ABS(revenue_neto - promedio_historico), 2)             AS desviacion_abs,
    -- Clasificamos la desviación: spike si supera 20% del promedio,
    -- caida si cae más del 20% por debajo
    CASE
        WHEN revenue_neto > promedio_historico * 1.2  THEN 'spike'
        WHEN revenue_neto < promedio_historico * 0.8  THEN 'caida'
        ELSE 'normal'
    END                                                          AS tipo_desviacion
FROM con_promedio
ORDER BY desviacion_abs DESC
LIMIT 5;
notes: La tabla returns NO tiene un campo de monto o cantidad de unidades devueltas — solo tiene return_id, product_id, order_id, reason y status. Esto es una limitacion real del schema que el analista debe documentar. La aproximacion mas limpia es contar devoluciones aprobadas como una unidad cada una y multiplicar por el precio promedio del producto. Este punto de limitacion del schema es el hallazgo que distingue al analista excelente.

title: Analisis de la anomalia de pagos de Chile en Q1 2026
reference_query:
WITH metricas_cliente AS (
    -- Una sola pasada por orders + order_items para las 3 métricas
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        JULIANDAY('2026-05-31') - JULIANDAY(MAX(o.ordered_at)) AS recencia_dias,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)                              AS frecuencia,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2)              AS monto_total
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    ROUND(recencia_dias, 0)                                     AS recencia_dias,
    frecuencia,
    monto_total,
    -- Los CASE se evalúan en orden: champion primero, luego leal, etc.
    CASE
        WHEN recencia_dias <= 30  AND frecuencia >= 3 THEN 'champion'
        WHEN recencia_dias <= 90  AND frecuencia >= 2 THEN 'leal'
        WHEN recencia_dias BETWEEN 91 AND 180         THEN 'en_riesgo'
        WHEN recencia_dias > 180                      THEN 'perdido'
        WHEN frecuencia = 1 AND recencia_dias <= 60   THEN 'nuevo'
        ELSE 'otros'
    END                                                         AS segmento_rfm
FROM metricas_cliente
ORDER BY monto_total DESC;
notes: Esta es la pregunta con mayor impacto de negocio del Capstone — es el punto que los inversores del fondo chileno van a preguntar primero. Segun la narrativa del seed, el credit_card tiene una tasa de fallo 40% superior en Chile durante mar-abr 2026 respecto al promedio historico. El analista excelente cuantifica este 40% con datos reales del seed.

title: Auditoria de integridad de la tabla payments
reference_query:
WITH primer_pedido AS (
    -- Mes y fecha exacta del primer pedido de cada cliente
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MIN(ordered_at)                                          AS primera_compra,
        STRFTIME('%Y-%m', MIN(ordered_at))                       AS cohorte
    FROM orders
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'processing', 'pending')
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
cohorte_base AS (
    -- Agrupamos por cohorte: cuántos clientes hay en cada mes
    SELECT
        cohorte,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)                              AS clientes_cohorte,
        MIN(primera_compra)                                      AS inicio_cohorte
    FROM primer_pedido
    GROUP BY cohorte
),
actividad_posterior AS (
    -- Todos los pedidos válidos para cruzar con las cohortes
    SELECT DISTINCT
        o.customer_id,
        STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.ordered_at)                          AS mes_actividad
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped', 'processing', 'pending')
)
SELECT
    cb.cohorte,
    cb.clientes_cohorte,
    -- Retención a 3 meses
    ROUND(
        COUNT(DISTINCT r3.customer_id) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(cb.clientes_cohorte, 0),
        1
    )                                                            AS ret_3m,
    -- Retención a 6 meses (solo cohortes anteriores a 2025-12)
    CASE
        WHEN cb.cohorte < '2025-12'
        THEN ROUND(
            COUNT(DISTINCT r6.customer_id) * 100.0
            / NULLIF(cb.clientes_cohorte, 0),
            1
        )
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                          AS ret_6m,
    -- Retención a 12 meses (solo cohortes anteriores a 2025-06)
    CASE
        WHEN cb.cohorte < '2025-06'
        THEN ROUND(
            COUNT(DISTINCT r12.customer_id) * 100.0
            / NULLIF(cb.clientes_cohorte, 0),
            1
        )
        ELSE NULL
    END                                                          AS ret_12m
FROM cohorte_base cb
-- Clientes de la cohorte que compraron exactamente en el mes cohorte+3
INNER JOIN primer_pedido pp ON pp.cohorte = cb.cohorte
LEFT JOIN actividad_posterior r3
    ON  r3.customer_id  = pp.customer_id
    AND r3.mes_actividad = STRFTIME('%Y-%m', DATE(pp.primera_compra, '+3 months'))
LEFT JOIN actividad_posterior r6
    ON  r6.customer_id  = pp.customer_id
    AND r6.mes_actividad = STRFTIME('%Y-%m', DATE(pp.primera_compra, '+6 months'))
LEFT JOIN actividad_posterior r12
    ON  r12.customer_id  = pp.customer_id
    AND r12.mes_actividad = STRFTIME('%Y-%m', DATE(pp.primera_compra, '+12 months'))
WHERE cb.cohorte >= '2023-06'
GROUP BY cb.cohorte, cb.clientes_cohorte
ORDER BY cb.cohorte;
notes: Esta pregunta es la unica del Capstone que no tiene una respuesta 'correcta' predeterminada: el resultado depende de la integridad real del seed. Si el seed no tiene anomalias de integridad, el resultado correcto es 0 registros para ambas anomalias. El analista excelente documenta los 0 como una afirmacion positiva de calidad de datos, no como ausencia de analisis. Esta es la pregunta que mas distingue a quienes entienden que el analisis de calidad de datos tiene valor aunque no encuentre problemas.

title: Clientes en riesgo de churn: ventana de 60-90 días
reference_query:
WITH ultimo_pedido_valido AS (
    -- Fecha del último pedido con status válido por cliente
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MAX(ordered_at)                                          AS ultimo_pedido
    FROM orders
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
historial_cliente AS (
    -- Revenue histórico y total de pedidos (todos los status)
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)                               AS total_pedidos,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2)               AS revenue_historico
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.email,
    c.country,
    upv.ultimo_pedido,
    ROUND(
        JULIANDAY('2026-05-31') - JULIANDAY(upv.ultimo_pedido),
        0
    )                                                            AS dias_sin_compra,
    hc.total_pedidos,
    hc.revenue_historico
FROM ultimo_pedido_valido upv
INNER JOIN customers      c  ON c.customer_id  = upv.customer_id
INNER JOIN historial_cliente hc ON hc.customer_id = upv.customer_id
WHERE JULIANDAY('2026-05-31') - JULIANDAY(upv.ultimo_pedido)
      BETWEEN 60 AND 90
ORDER BY hc.revenue_historico DESC;
notes: Resultados reales precalculados desde el dataset SQLite.

title: Clientes de alto valor: distribución por país y canal
reference_query:
WITH revenue_por_cliente AS (
    -- Revenue de pedidos entregados o enviados por cliente
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2)               AS revenue_total
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
quintiles AS (
    -- Clasificamos en quintiles: quintil 1 = top 20% por revenue
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        revenue_total,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY revenue_total DESC)              AS quintil
    FROM revenue_por_cliente
),
alto_valor AS (
    -- Solo los del top 20%
    SELECT customer_id, revenue_total
    FROM quintiles
    WHERE quintil = 1
),
primera_sesion AS (
    -- Primera sesión de cada cliente para atribución first-touch
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        campaign_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY started_at ASC
        )                                                        AS rn
    FROM website_sessions
),
canal_adquisicion AS (
    -- Canal de la primera sesión; organic si no hay campaña
    SELECT
        ps.customer_id,
        COALESCE(mc.channel, 'organic')                          AS canal
    FROM primera_sesion ps
    LEFT JOIN marketing_campaigns mc ON mc.campaign_id = ps.campaign_id
    WHERE ps.rn = 1
)
SELECT
    c.country,
    COALESCE(ca.canal, 'sin_sesion')                             AS canal,
    COUNT(DISTINCT av.customer_id)                               AS clientes_alto_valor,
    ROUND(SUM(av.revenue_total), 2)                              AS revenue_total,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(DISTINCT av.customer_id) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT av.customer_id)) OVER (), 0),
        1
    )                                                            AS pct_clientes
FROM alto_valor av
INNER JOIN customers       c  ON c.customer_id  = av.customer_id
LEFT  JOIN canal_adquisicion ca ON ca.customer_id = av.customer_id
GROUP BY c.country, COALESCE(ca.canal, 'sin_sesion')
ORDER BY clientes_alto_valor DESC;
notes: Resultados reales precalculados desde el dataset SQLite.

title: LTV real: revenue acumulado por mes de vida del cliente
reference_query:
WITH primer_pedido_fecha AS (
    -- Fecha exacta del primer pedido de cada cliente
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MIN(ordered_at)                                          AS primera_compra
    FROM orders
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
pedidos_con_vida AS (
    -- Para cada pedido, calculamos en qué mes de vida del cliente cayó
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_id,
        CAST(
            (JULIANDAY(o.ordered_at) - JULIANDAY(pp.primera_compra))
            / 30.44
            AS INT
        )                                                        AS mes_de_vida,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)                         AS revenue_pedido
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items     oi ON oi.order_id    = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN primer_pedido_fecha pp ON pp.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id,
             CAST((JULIANDAY(o.ordered_at) - JULIANDAY(pp.primera_compra)) / 30.44 AS INT)
),
revenue_por_cliente_mes AS (
    -- Revenue total de cada cliente en cada mes de vida
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        mes_de_vida,
        SUM(revenue_pedido)                                      AS revenue_en_mes
    FROM pedidos_con_vida
    GROUP BY customer_id, mes_de_vida
),
ltv_por_mes AS (
    -- Promedio entre todos los clientes activos en ese mes de vida
    SELECT
        mes_de_vida,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)                              AS clientes_activos,
        ROUND(AVG(revenue_en_mes), 2)                            AS revenue_promedio
    FROM revenue_por_cliente_mes
    GROUP BY mes_de_vida
)
SELECT
    mes_de_vida,
    clientes_activos,
    revenue_promedio,
    -- Running total: LTV acumulado promedio por mes de vida
    ROUND(
        SUM(revenue_promedio) OVER (
            ORDER BY mes_de_vida ASC
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ),
        2
    )                                                            AS ltv_acumulado
FROM ltv_por_mes
WHERE mes_de_vida <= 24
ORDER BY mes_de_vida ASC;
notes: Resultados reales precalculados desde el dataset SQLite.

title: Net Revenue por cliente: bruto menos impacto de devoluciones
reference_query:
WITH ventas_cliente AS (
    -- Revenue bruto y unidades vendidas por cliente
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2)               AS revenue_bruto,
        SUM(oi.quantity)                                         AS unidades_totales
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
devoluciones_cliente AS (
    -- NOTA: returns no tiene campo de monto.
    -- Contamos cada return aprobado para estimar el impacto.
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(r.return_id)                                       AS devoluciones_aprobadas
    FROM returns r
    INNER JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE r.status = 'approved'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.country,
    vc.revenue_bruto,
    COALESCE(dc.devoluciones_aprobadas, 0)                       AS devoluciones_aprobadas,
    -- Impacto: cada devolución aprobada se valúa al precio promedio del cliente
    -- NOTA TÉCNICA: estimación — returns no registra monto devuelto
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(dc.devoluciones_aprobadas, 0)
        * (vc.revenue_bruto / NULLIF(vc.unidades_totales, 0)),
        2
    )                                                            AS impacto_devoluciones,
    ROUND(
        vc.revenue_bruto
        - COALESCE(dc.devoluciones_aprobadas, 0)
          * (vc.revenue_bruto / NULLIF(vc.unidades_totales, 0)),
        2
    )                                                            AS revenue_neto
FROM ventas_cliente vc
INNER JOIN customers        c  ON c.customer_id  = vc.customer_id
LEFT  JOIN devoluciones_cliente dc ON dc.customer_id = vc.customer_id
WHERE vc.revenue_bruto
      - COALESCE(dc.devoluciones_aprobadas, 0)
        * (vc.revenue_bruto / NULLIF(vc.unidades_totales, 0))
      > 0
ORDER BY revenue_neto DESC
LIMIT 20;
notes: Resultados reales precalculados desde el dataset SQLite.

title: ROI por canal: first-touch attribution en H1 2026
reference_query:
WITH primera_sesion_h1 AS (
    -- Primera sesión de cada cliente en H1 2026
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        campaign_id,
        started_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY started_at ASC
        )                                                        AS rn
    FROM website_sessions
    WHERE started_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND started_at <  '2026-07-01'
),
canal_origen AS (
    -- Canal de adquisición de la primera sesión H1 2026
    SELECT
        ps.customer_id,
        COALESCE(mc.channel, 'organic')                          AS canal
    FROM primera_sesion_h1 ps
    LEFT JOIN marketing_campaigns mc ON mc.campaign_id = ps.campaign_id
    WHERE ps.rn = 1
),
revenue_cliente AS (
    -- Revenue total de pedidos válidos por cliente
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)                         AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
gasto_por_canal AS (
    -- Gasto real de campañas activas durante H1 2026 por canal
    SELECT
        channel                                                  AS canal,
        ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(spent, 0)), 2)                        AS gasto_canal
    FROM marketing_campaigns
    WHERE started_at < '2026-07-01'
      AND (ended_at >= '2026-01-01' OR ended_at IS NULL)
    GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT
    co.canal,
    COUNT(DISTINCT co.customer_id)                               AS clientes_adquiridos,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(rc.revenue), 0), 2)                       AS revenue_atribuido,
    ROUND(COALESCE(gc.gasto_canal, 0), 2)                        AS gasto_canal,
    -- ROI: si no hay gasto (organic), el denominador es 0 -> NULL via NULLIF
    ROUND(
        (COALESCE(SUM(rc.revenue), 0) - COALESCE(gc.gasto_canal, 0))
        * 100.0
        / NULLIF(COALESCE(gc.gasto_canal, 0), 0),
        1
    )                                                            AS roi_pct
FROM canal_origen co
LEFT JOIN revenue_cliente    rc ON rc.customer_id = co.customer_id
LEFT JOIN gasto_por_canal    gc ON gc.canal       = co.canal
GROUP BY co.canal, gc.gasto_canal
ORDER BY roi_pct DESC NULLS LAST;

title: Tasa de conversión y CPA por canal en H1 2026
reference_query:
WITH sesiones_h1 AS (
    -- Sesiones de H1 2026 con canal asignado
    SELECT
        ws.session_id,
        ws.customer_id,
        ws.converted,
        COALESCE(mc.channel, 'organic')                          AS canal
    FROM website_sessions ws
    LEFT JOIN marketing_campaigns mc ON mc.campaign_id = ws.campaign_id
    WHERE ws.started_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND ws.started_at <  '2026-07-01'
),
primera_sesion_historica AS (
    -- Primera sesión de cada cliente en toda la historia
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        campaign_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY started_at ASC
        )                                                        AS rn
    FROM website_sessions
),
nuevos_por_canal AS (
    -- Clientes cuya primera sesión ever pertenece a cada canal
    SELECT
        COALESCE(mc.channel, 'organic')                          AS canal,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ps.customer_id)                           AS nuevos_clientes
    FROM primera_sesion_historica ps
    LEFT JOIN marketing_campaigns mc ON mc.campaign_id = ps.campaign_id
    WHERE ps.rn = 1
    GROUP BY COALESCE(mc.channel, 'organic')
),
gasto_por_canal AS (
    SELECT
        channel                                                  AS canal,
        ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(spent, 0)), 2)                        AS gasto_canal
    FROM marketing_campaigns
    WHERE started_at < '2026-07-01'
      AND (ended_at >= '2026-01-01' OR ended_at IS NULL)
    GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT
    sh.canal,
    COUNT(sh.session_id)                                         AS total_sesiones,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sh.converted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)           AS sesiones_convertidas,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN sh.converted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(COUNT(sh.session_id), 0),
        1
    )                                                            AS tasa_conversion_pct,
    COALESCE(nc.nuevos_clientes, 0)                              AS nuevos_clientes,
    ROUND(COALESCE(gc.gasto_canal, 0), 2)                        AS gasto_canal,
    -- CPA: costo por adquisición histórica (no solo H1)
    -- NOTA: nuevos_clientes es histórico; gasto solo H1 — comparar con cautela
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(gc.gasto_canal, 0)
        / NULLIF(COALESCE(nc.nuevos_clientes, 0), 0),
        2
    )                                                            AS cpa
FROM sesiones_h1 sh
LEFT JOIN nuevos_por_canal nc ON nc.canal = sh.canal
LEFT JOIN gasto_por_canal  gc ON gc.canal = sh.canal
GROUP BY sh.canal, nc.nuevos_clientes, gc.gasto_canal
ORDER BY tasa_conversion_pct DESC;

title: Campañas: ranking por ROI dentro de cada canal
reference_query:
WITH sesiones_h1_campana AS (
    -- Sesiones de H1 2026 por campaña (solo las que tienen campaign_id)
    SELECT
        campaign_id,
        COUNT(*)                                                 AS sesiones,
        SUM(CASE WHEN converted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)          AS conversiones
    FROM website_sessions
    WHERE started_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND started_at <  '2026-07-01'
      AND campaign_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY campaign_id
),
primera_sesion_historica AS (
    -- Primera sesión histórica de cada cliente
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        campaign_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY started_at ASC
        )                                                        AS rn
    FROM website_sessions
    WHERE campaign_id IS NOT NULL
),
revenue_por_campana AS (
    -- Revenue histórico de clientes cuya primera sesión fue esa campaña
    SELECT
        ps.campaign_id,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2)               AS revenue_atribuido
    FROM primera_sesion_historica ps
    INNER JOIN orders o       ON o.customer_id  = ps.customer_id
                              AND o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id    = o.order_id
    WHERE ps.rn = 1
    GROUP BY ps.campaign_id
)
SELECT
    mc.channel                                                   AS canal,
    mc.name                                                      AS campana,
    sh.sesiones,
    sh.conversiones,
    ROUND(COALESCE(rc.revenue_atribuido, 0), 2)                  AS revenue_atribuido,
    ROUND(COALESCE(mc.spent, 0), 2)                              AS gasto,
    ROUND(
        (COALESCE(rc.revenue_atribuido, 0) - COALESCE(mc.spent, 0))
        * 100.0
        / NULLIF(COALESCE(mc.spent, 0), 0),
        1
    )                                                            AS roi_campana_pct,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY mc.channel
        ORDER BY
            (COALESCE(rc.revenue_atribuido, 0) - COALESCE(mc.spent, 0))
            / NULLIF(COALESCE(mc.spent, 0), 0) DESC
    )                                                            AS rank_en_canal
FROM marketing_campaigns mc
INNER JOIN sesiones_h1_campana sh ON sh.campaign_id = mc.campaign_id
LEFT  JOIN revenue_por_campana rc ON rc.campaign_id = mc.campaign_id
ORDER BY canal ASC, rank_en_canal ASC;

title: Funnel de conversión por canal: sesiones → revenue
reference_query:
WITH sesiones_h1_con_canal AS (
    -- Todas las sesiones de H1 2026 con canal asignado
    SELECT
        ws.session_id,
        ws.customer_id,
        ws.converted,
        COALESCE(mc.channel, 'organic')                          AS canal
    FROM website_sessions ws
    LEFT JOIN marketing_campaigns mc ON mc.campaign_id = ws.campaign_id
    WHERE ws.started_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND ws.started_at <  '2026-07-01'
),
primera_sesion_h1 AS (
    -- Primera sesión de H1 de cada cliente para atribución
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        canal,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY session_id ASC        -- session_id como proxy de orden temporal
        )                                                        AS rn
    FROM sesiones_h1_con_canal
),
canal_primera_sesion AS (
    -- Solo la primera sesión por cliente en H1
    SELECT customer_id, canal
    FROM primera_sesion_h1
    WHERE rn = 1
),
pedidos_revenue_h1 AS (
    -- Pedidos y revenue de H1 2026 para esos clientes
    SELECT
        cp.canal,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)                               AS pedidos_generados,
        ROUND(
            SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
                     THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                     ELSE 0 END),
            2
        )                                                        AS revenue_h1
    FROM canal_primera_sesion cp
    INNER JOIN orders     o  ON o.customer_id = cp.customer_id
                             AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01'
                             AND o.ordered_at <  '2026-07-01'
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY cp.canal
),
metricas_sesion AS (
    -- Métricas de sesión por canal en H1
    SELECT
        canal,
        COUNT(session_id)                                        AS sesiones,
        SUM(CASE WHEN converted = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)          AS sesiones_convertidas
    FROM sesiones_h1_con_canal
    GROUP BY canal
)
SELECT
    ms.canal,
    ms.sesiones,
    ms.sesiones_convertidas,
    COALESCE(pr.pedidos_generados, 0)                            AS pedidos_generados,
    COALESCE(pr.revenue_h1, 0.00)                                AS revenue_h1,
    ROUND(
        ms.sesiones_convertidas * 100.0
        / NULLIF(ms.sesiones, 0),
        1
    )                                                            AS tasa_conversion_pct,
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(pr.pedidos_generados, 0) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(ms.sesiones, 0),
        1
    )                                                            AS tasa_sesion_pedido,
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(pr.revenue_h1, 0)
        / NULLIF(ms.sesiones, 0),
        2
    )                                                            AS revenue_por_sesion
FROM metricas_sesion ms
LEFT JOIN pedidos_revenue_h1 pr ON pr.canal = ms.canal
ORDER BY revenue_h1 DESC;

title: Anomalía Chile: pagos fallidos en marzo-abril 2026
reference_query:
WITH fallos_chile AS (
    -- Pagos fallidos de Chile en mar-abr 2026
    SELECT
        p.payment_id,
        p.amount
    FROM payments p
    INNER JOIN orders    o ON o.order_id    = p.order_id
    INNER JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE c.country   = 'Chile'
      AND p.status    = 'failed'
      AND p.paid_at  >= '2026-03-01'
      AND p.paid_at  <  '2026-05-01'
),
revenue_chile_h1 AS (
    -- Revenue neto de Chile en todo H1 2026
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'completed' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'refunded'  THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_neto
    FROM payments p
    INNER JOIN orders    o ON o.order_id    = p.order_id
    INNER JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE c.country  = 'Chile'
      AND p.paid_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND p.paid_at <  '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT
    COUNT(fc.payment_id)                                         AS total_fallos_chile_mar_abr,
    ROUND(SUM(fc.amount), 2)                                     AS monto_en_riesgo,
    ROUND(rh.revenue_neto, 2)                                    AS revenue_chile_h1,
    ROUND(
        SUM(fc.amount) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(rh.revenue_neto, 0),
        1
    )                                                            AS pct_impacto
FROM fallos_chile fc
CROSS JOIN revenue_chile_h1 rh;

title: Stock crítico: productos con inventario bajo y alta rotación
reference_query:
WITH stock_actual AS (
    -- Stock más reciente por producto (en caso de múltiples registros)
    SELECT
        i.product_id,
        i.stock
    FROM inventory i
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT product_id, MAX(updated_at) AS ultima_actualizacion
        FROM inventory
        GROUP BY product_id
    ) ultimo ON ultimo.product_id = i.product_id
           AND ultimo.ultima_actualizacion = i.updated_at
),
ventas_90d AS (
    -- Unidades vendidas en los últimos 90 días desde 2026-05-31
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity)                                         AS unidades_90d
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
      AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-03-02'      -- 2026-05-31 - 90 días
      AND o.ordered_at <  '2026-06-01'
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
cobertura AS (
    -- Combinamos stock con ventas para calcular cobertura
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.name                                                   AS producto,
        cat.name                                                 AS categoria,
        COALESCE(sa.stock, 0)                                    AS stock_actual,
        COALESCE(v.unidades_90d, 0)                              AS unidades_90d,
        ROUND(COALESCE(v.unidades_90d, 0) / 90.0, 2)            AS ventas_diarias,
        ROUND(
            COALESCE(sa.stock, 0)
            / NULLIF(COALESCE(v.unidades_90d, 0) / 90.0, 0),
            1
        )                                                        AS dias_cobertura
    FROM products p
    INNER JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    LEFT  JOIN stock_actual  sa  ON sa.product_id  = p.product_id
    LEFT  JOIN ventas_90d    v   ON v.product_id   = p.product_id
    WHERE p.is_active = 1
)
SELECT
    producto,
    categoria,
    stock_actual,
    unidades_90d,
    ventas_diarias,
    dias_cobertura,
    CASE
        WHEN dias_cobertura < 15                    THEN 'critico'
        WHEN dias_cobertura BETWEEN 15 AND 30       THEN 'alerta'
        WHEN dias_cobertura > 30                    THEN 'adecuado'
        ELSE 'sin_ventas'
    END                                                          AS nivel_urgencia
FROM cobertura
WHERE
    -- Solo mostramos los que requieren atención
    dias_cobertura < 15
    OR (dias_cobertura BETWEEN 15 AND 30)
ORDER BY dias_cobertura ASC NULLS FIRST;

title: Análisis de devoluciones por categoría con tendencia MoM
reference_query:
WITH pedidos_categoria AS (
    -- Pedidos por categoría y mes (base del denominador)
    SELECT
        cat.name                                                 AS categoria,
        STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.ordered_at)                          AS mes,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)                               AS pedidos_mes
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi  ON oi.order_id   = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN products    p   ON p.product_id  = oi.product_id
    INNER JOIN categories  cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    WHERE o.ordered_at >= '2025-01-01'
      AND o.ordered_at <  '2026-07-01'
    GROUP BY cat.name, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.ordered_at)
),
devoluciones_categoria AS (
    -- Returns aprobados por categoría y mes (por fecha del return)
    SELECT
        cat.name                                                 AS categoria,
        STRFTIME('%Y-%m', r.returned_at)                         AS mes,
        COUNT(r.return_id)                                       AS devoluciones_mes
    FROM returns r
    INNER JOIN orders     o   ON o.order_id   = r.order_id
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id  = o.order_id
    INNER JOIN products   p   ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    INNER JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
    WHERE r.status = 'approved'
      AND r.returned_at >= '2025-01-01'
      AND r.returned_at <  '2026-07-01'
    GROUP BY cat.name, STRFTIME('%Y-%m', r.returned_at)
),
combinado AS (
    -- Combinamos pedidos con devoluciones
    SELECT
        pc.categoria,
        pc.mes,
        pc.pedidos_mes,
        COALESCE(dc.devoluciones_mes, 0)                         AS devoluciones_mes,
        ROUND(
            COALESCE(dc.devoluciones_mes, 0) * 100.0
            / NULLIF(pc.pedidos_mes, 0),
            1
        )                                                        AS tasa_devolucion_pct
    FROM pedidos_categoria pc
    LEFT JOIN devoluciones_categoria dc
        ON  dc.categoria = pc.categoria
        AND dc.mes       = pc.mes
)
SELECT
    categoria,
    mes,
    pedidos_mes,
    devoluciones_mes,
    tasa_devolucion_pct,
    ROUND(
        LAG(tasa_devolucion_pct) OVER (
            PARTITION BY categoria
            ORDER BY mes ASC
        ),
        1
    )                                                            AS tasa_anterior,
    ROUND(
        tasa_devolucion_pct
        - LAG(tasa_devolucion_pct) OVER (
            PARTITION BY categoria
            ORDER BY mes ASC
        ),
        1
    )                                                            AS variacion_mom
FROM combinado
ORDER BY categoria ASC, mes ASC;

title: Auditoría de integridad: pedidos sin pago y pagos huérfanos
reference_query:
WITH pedidos_sin_pago AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2)               AS monto_estimado
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM payments p
          WHERE p.order_id = o.order_id
            AND p.status   = 'completed'
      )
    GROUP BY o.order_id
),
pagos_sin_fecha AS (
    SELECT
        payment_id,
        ROUND(amount, 2)                                         AS monto_estimado
    FROM payments
    WHERE status  = 'completed'
      AND paid_at IS NULL
)
SELECT
    'pedido_sin_pago_completado'                                 AS tipo_anomalia,
    CAST(order_id AS TEXT)                                       AS referencia_id,
    'status: delivered, sin payment completed'                   AS detalle,
    monto_estimado
FROM pedidos_sin_pago

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'pago_completado_sin_fecha'                                  AS tipo_anomalia,
    CAST(payment_id AS TEXT)                                     AS referencia_id,
    'status: completed, paid_at NULL'                            AS detalle,
    monto_estimado
FROM pagos_sin_fecha

ORDER BY tipo_anomalia ASC, monto_estimado DESC;
notes: PARTE A — detalle individual de anomalías. Resultados reales precalculados desde el dataset SQLite.

title: Productos zombie y catálogo obsoleto
reference_query:
WITH stock_actual AS (
    -- Stock más reciente por producto
    SELECT
        i.product_id,
        i.stock
    FROM inventory i
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT product_id, MAX(updated_at) AS ultima_actualizacion
        FROM inventory
        GROUP BY product_id
    ) ult ON ult.product_id = i.product_id
         AND ult.ultima_actualizacion = i.updated_at
),
ultima_venta_historica AS (
    -- Fecha del último pedido válido por producto (toda la historia)
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        MAX(o.ordered_at)                                        AS ultima_venta
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
productos_sin_venta_reciente AS (
    -- Productos activos sin ninguna venta en los últimos 6 meses
    SELECT DISTINCT oi.product_id
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status      IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
      AND o.ordered_at  >= '2025-12-01'
      AND o.ordered_at  <  '2026-06-01'
)
SELECT
    p.name                                                       AS producto,
    cat.name                                                     AS categoria,
    ROUND(p.price, 2)                                            AS precio,
    COALESCE(sa.stock, 0)                                        AS stock_actual,
    uv.ultima_venta,
    ROUND(
        JULIANDAY('2026-05-31') - JULIANDAY(uv.ultima_venta),
        0
    )                                                            AS dias_desde_venta,
    CASE
        WHEN uv.ultima_venta IS NULL THEN 'nunca_vendido'
        ELSE 'obsoleto_6m'
    END                                                          AS clasificacion
FROM products p
INNER JOIN categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
LEFT  JOIN stock_actual  sa ON sa.product_id  = p.product_id
LEFT  JOIN ultima_venta_historica uv ON uv.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.is_active = 1
  -- Excluimos los que sí tuvieron ventas en los últimos 6 meses
  AND p.product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM productos_sin_venta_reciente)
ORDER BY clasificacion ASC, dias_desde_venta DESC NULLS FIRST;
notes: Resultados reales precalculados desde el dataset SQLite.

title: Dashboard ejecutivo H1 2026 vs. H1 2025
reference_query:
WITH pagos AS (
    -- Revenue neto por período (completed - refunded)
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed'
                  AND paid_at >= '2025-01-01'
                  AND paid_at <  '2025-07-01'
                 THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded'
                    AND paid_at >= '2025-01-01'
                    AND paid_at <  '2025-07-01'
                   THEN amount ELSE 0 END)                       AS revenue_h1_2025,
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed'
                  AND paid_at >= '2026-01-01'
                  AND paid_at <  '2026-07-01'
                 THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'refunded'
                    AND paid_at >= '2026-01-01'
                    AND paid_at <  '2026-07-01'
                   THEN amount ELSE 0 END)                       AS revenue_h1_2026
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at IS NOT NULL
),
pedidos AS (
    -- Total de pedidos por período
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ordered_at >= '2025-01-01'
                             AND ordered_at <  '2025-07-01'
                            THEN order_id END)                   AS pedidos_h1_2025,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ordered_at >= '2026-01-01'
                             AND ordered_at <  '2026-07-01'
                            THEN order_id END)                   AS pedidos_h1_2026
    FROM orders
),
nuevos_clientes AS (
    -- Clientes cuyo primer pedido fue en cada período
    SELECT
        COUNT(CASE WHEN primer_pedido >= '2025-01-01'
                    AND primer_pedido <  '2025-07-01'
                   THEN 1 END)                                   AS nuevos_h1_2025,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN primer_pedido >= '2026-01-01'
                    AND primer_pedido <  '2026-07-01'
                   THEN 1 END)                                   AS nuevos_h1_2026
    FROM (
        SELECT customer_id, MIN(ordered_at) AS primer_pedido
        FROM orders
        GROUP BY customer_id
    ) primeros
),
devoluciones AS (
    -- Returns aprobados por período (por fecha del return)
    SELECT
        COUNT(CASE WHEN returned_at >= '2025-01-01'
                    AND returned_at <  '2025-07-01'
                    AND status = 'approved'
                   THEN 1 END)                                   AS devol_h1_2025,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN returned_at >= '2026-01-01'
                    AND returned_at <  '2026-07-01'
                    AND status = 'approved'
                   THEN 1 END)                                   AS devol_h1_2026
    FROM returns
),
kpis AS (
    -- Combinamos todo en una sola fila con CROSS JOIN
    SELECT
        p.revenue_h1_2025,
        p.revenue_h1_2026,
        pe.pedidos_h1_2025,
        pe.pedidos_h1_2026,
        nc.nuevos_h1_2025,
        nc.nuevos_h1_2026,
        d.devol_h1_2025,
        d.devol_h1_2026
    FROM pagos p
    CROSS JOIN pedidos       pe
    CROSS JOIN nuevos_clientes nc
    CROSS JOIN devoluciones  d
)
-- Resultado final: una fila por KPI con comparación H1 2025 vs H1 2026
SELECT 1 AS orden, 'revenue_neto'        AS kpi,
    ROUND(revenue_h1_2025, 2)            AS valor_h1_2025,
    ROUND(revenue_h1_2026, 2)            AS valor_h1_2026,
    ROUND((revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025) * 100.0
          / NULLIF(revenue_h1_2025, 0), 1) AS variacion_pct
FROM kpis

UNION ALL

SELECT 2, 'pedidos_totales',
    ROUND(CAST(pedidos_h1_2025 AS REAL), 2),
    ROUND(CAST(pedidos_h1_2026 AS REAL), 2),
    ROUND((pedidos_h1_2026 - pedidos_h1_2025) * 100.0
          / NULLIF(pedidos_h1_2025, 0), 1)
FROM kpis

UNION ALL

SELECT 3, 'ticket_promedio',
    ROUND(revenue_h1_2025 / NULLIF(pedidos_h1_2025, 0), 2),
    ROUND(revenue_h1_2026 / NULLIF(pedidos_h1_2026, 0), 2),
    ROUND(
        (   revenue_h1_2026 / NULLIF(pedidos_h1_2026, 0)
          - revenue_h1_2025 / NULLIF(pedidos_h1_2025, 0)
        ) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(revenue_h1_2025 / NULLIF(pedidos_h1_2025, 0), 0),
        1
    )
FROM kpis

UNION ALL

SELECT 4, 'nuevos_clientes',
    ROUND(CAST(nuevos_h1_2025 AS REAL), 2),
    ROUND(CAST(nuevos_h1_2026 AS REAL), 2),
    ROUND((nuevos_h1_2026 - nuevos_h1_2025) * 100.0
          / NULLIF(nuevos_h1_2025, 0), 1)
FROM kpis

UNION ALL

SELECT 5, 'tasa_devolucion_pct',
    ROUND(devol_h1_2025 * 100.0 / NULLIF(pedidos_h1_2025, 0), 2),
    ROUND(devol_h1_2026 * 100.0 / NULLIF(pedidos_h1_2026, 0), 2),
    ROUND(
        (   devol_h1_2026 * 100.0 / NULLIF(pedidos_h1_2026, 0)
          - devol_h1_2025 * 100.0 / NULLIF(pedidos_h1_2025, 0)
        ) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(devol_h1_2025 * 100.0 / NULLIF(pedidos_h1_2025, 0), 0),
        1
    )
FROM kpis

ORDER BY orden;

title: Vista reutilizable: resumen de salud del negocio
reference_query:
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v_salud_negocio;

CREATE VIEW v_salud_negocio AS
WITH stock_mas_reciente AS (
    -- Stock actual por producto (registro más reciente)
    SELECT
        i.product_id,
        i.stock
    FROM inventory i
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT product_id, MAX(updated_at) AS ultima
        FROM inventory
        GROUP BY product_id
    ) ult ON ult.product_id = i.product_id
         AND ult.ultima      = i.updated_at
),
ultimo_pedido_cliente AS (
    -- Fecha del último pedido válido por cliente
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MAX(ordered_at)                                          AS ultimo_pedido
    FROM orders
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    -- Salud del catálogo
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE is_active = 1)          AS productos_activos,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE is_active = 0)          AS productos_inactivos,
    -- Stock crítico: umbral < 20 unidades (definido por Diego Morales en
    -- la reunión de operaciones de mayo 2026 como mínimo operacional)
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id)
        FROM products p
        INNER JOIN stock_mas_reciente smr ON smr.product_id = p.product_id
        WHERE p.is_active = 1
          AND smr.stock   < 20
    )                                                            AS productos_stock_critico,
    -- Campañas de marketing activas
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM marketing_campaigns
        WHERE ended_at IS NULL
           OR ended_at >= '2026-05-31'
    )                                                            AS campanas_activas,
    -- Clientes en ventana de riesgo de churn (60-90 días sin comprar)
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM ultimo_pedido_cliente
        WHERE JULIANDAY('2026-05-31') - JULIANDAY(ultimo_pedido)
              BETWEEN 60 AND 90
    )                                                            AS clientes_alerta_churn,
    -- Devoluciones esperando resolución
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM returns
        WHERE status = 'pending'
    )                                                            AS devol_pendientes;

title: Score card de la anomalía Chile: impacto cuantificado
reference_query:
WITH pagos_mar_abr_chile AS (
    -- Pagos de Chile en mar-abr 2026 con indicador de fallo
    SELECT
        p.payment_id,
        p.method,
        p.status,
        p.amount
    FROM payments p
    INNER JOIN orders    o ON o.order_id    = p.order_id
    INNER JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE c.country  = 'Chile'
      AND p.paid_at >= '2026-03-01'
      AND p.paid_at <  '2026-05-01'
),
pagos_mar_abr_otros AS (
    -- Pagos del resto de países en mar-abr 2026
    SELECT
        p.payment_id,
        p.method,
        p.status,
        p.amount
    FROM payments p
    INNER JOIN orders    o ON o.order_id    = p.order_id
    INNER JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE c.country != 'Chile'
      AND p.paid_at >= '2026-03-01'
      AND p.paid_at <  '2026-05-01'
),
metodo_mas_afectado AS (
    -- El método con más fallos en Chile en el período
    SELECT method
    FROM pagos_mar_abr_chile
    WHERE status = 'failed'
    GROUP BY method
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
metricas_metodo_chile AS (
    -- Métricas del método más afectado en Chile
    SELECT
        pmc.method,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pmc.status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS fallos,
        COUNT(*)                                                 AS intentos,
        ROUND(
            SUM(CASE WHEN pmc.status = 'failed' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100,
            1
        )                                                        AS tasa_fallo_chile,
        ROUND(
            SUM(CASE WHEN pmc.status = 'failed' THEN pmc.amount ELSE 0 END),
            2
        )                                                        AS monto_fallos
    FROM pagos_mar_abr_chile pmc
    INNER JOIN metodo_mas_afectado mma ON mma.method = pmc.method
    GROUP BY pmc.method
),
tasa_base_otros AS (
    -- Tasa de fallo del mismo método en el resto del mundo
    SELECT
        ROUND(
            SUM(CASE WHEN pmo.status = 'failed' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100,
            1
        )                                                        AS tasa_fallo_base
    FROM pagos_mar_abr_otros pmo
    INNER JOIN metodo_mas_afectado mma ON mma.method = pmo.method
),
revenue_chile_h1 AS (
    -- Revenue neto de Chile en todo H1 2026
    SELECT
        ROUND(
            SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'completed' THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'refunded'  THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END),
            2
        )                                                        AS revenue_h1
    FROM payments p
    INNER JOIN orders    o ON o.order_id    = p.order_id
    INNER JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE c.country  = 'Chile'
      AND p.paid_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND p.paid_at <  '2026-07-01'
      AND p.paid_at IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    mmc.method                                                   AS metodo_mas_afectado,
    mmc.fallos                                                   AS fallos_ese_metodo,
    mmc.intentos                                                 AS intentos_ese_metodo,
    mmc.tasa_fallo_chile                                         AS tasa_fallo_metodo_pct,
    tbo.tasa_fallo_base,
    ROUND(mmc.tasa_fallo_chile - tbo.tasa_fallo_base, 1)         AS diferencia_pp,
    mmc.monto_fallos                                             AS monto_fallos_chile,
    rch.revenue_h1                                               AS revenue_chile_h1_2026,
    ROUND(
        mmc.monto_fallos * 100.0
        / NULLIF(rch.revenue_h1, 0),
        1
    )                                                            AS impacto_sobre_revenue
FROM metricas_metodo_chile mmc
CROSS JOIN tasa_base_otros   tbo
CROSS JOIN revenue_chile_h1  rch;

-- HALLAZGO: Hay capital inmovilizado en stock de productos zombie
-- que podría liberarse con descuentos antes de la expansión.

WITH stock_actual AS (
    SELECT
        i.product_id,
        i.stock
    FROM inventory i
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT product_id, MAX(updated_at) AS ultima
        FROM inventory
        GROUP BY product_id
    ) ult ON ult.product_id = i.product_id
         AND ult.ultima      = i.updated_at
),
productos_sin_venta_reciente AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT oi.product_id
    FROM order_items oi
    INNER JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status     IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
      AND o.ordered_at >= '2025-12-01'
      AND o.ordered_at <  '2026-06-01'
)
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_id)                                 AS productos_zombie,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(sa.stock, 0) * p.price), 2)               AS capital_inmovilizado,
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(sa.stock, 0)), 1)                         AS stock_promedio_zombie,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cat.name)                                     AS categorias_afectadas
FROM products p
INNER JOIN categories  cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
LEFT  JOIN stock_actual sa  ON sa.product_id  = p.product_id
WHERE p.is_active = 1
  AND p.product_id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM productos_sin_venta_reciente);

-- INTERPRETACIÓN PARA MARCO:
-- "Hay [N] productos activos en el catálogo sin ninguna venta
--  en los últimos 6 meses, con $[X] en stock inmovilizado al
--  precio de catálogo. Antes de la expansión a Brasil y Ecuador,
--  liquidar ese inventario con un 20-30% de descuento liberaría
--  capital y limpiaría el catálogo — un catálogo más pequeño
--  pero más rentable es más fácil de escalar en un mercado nuevo."
